title: echinochloa frumentacea subsp. utilis
intro: Echinochloa frumentacea subsp. utilis, commonly known as Japanese barnyard millet or Job's tears, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is a traditional plant used in Asian medicine, known for its health benefits, including its ability to improve digestion, lower blood pressure, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Japanese barnyard millet include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides. The bioactive constituents of Japanese barnyard millet, including its flavonoids and phenolic acids, are responsible for its various therapeutic actions and health benefits.
